Loading libraries
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(flexdashboard)
library(p8105.datasets)
  data("instacart")
```

Loading data
```{r}
instacart_df = 
  instacart |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  group_by(
    product_id, product_name
  ) |> 
  summarize(
    n_purchases = n(),
    mean_cart_position = mean(add_to_cart_order),
    reorder_rate = mean(reordered)
  ) |> 
  ungroup()
```

### Scatterplot: 
* no missing variables through skimr

```{r}
instacart_df |> 
  filter(n_purchases >=20) |> 
  mutate(text_label = str_c("Product: ", product_name, "\nPurchases: ", n_purchases)) |> 
  plot_ly(
    x = ~mean_cart_position,
    y = ~reorder_rate,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers",
    color = ~n_purchases,
    text = ~text_label,
    alpha = 0.5
  )
```
